name: the capability metadata is reported
description: GET /api/db/meta reports the small, cheap description the PHP consumer reads before it routes the database console through the service: the wire-contract version it must understand, the namespace it must match against storage.default-namespace, where the topology came from, and the capability endpoints this build serves. It runs no query and names no host or credential, so it is the one /api/db route that can not fail on the cluster. The contract server configures a file-based topology in the 'phorge' namespace.
